properties.areaDesc: Citrus, FL; Levy, FL; Marion, FL
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 16 at 9:14PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

Withlacoochee At US 41 Dunnellon affecting Marion, Citrus and Levy
Counties.

.The Withlacoochee River at Dunnellon (US 41) has been steadily
rising since July and on September 15, reached flood stage. The cause
of the high water along the Withlacoochee River at Dunnellon is
excessive hydrilla growth (from river bottom to the water surface)
along a 4.5 mile stretch of river between US 41 and Lake Rousseau.
The hydrilla is acting like a dam and holding water back, causing
water levels to rise.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and is forecast to continue.

* WHERE...Withlacoochee at US 41 Dunnellon.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 28.2 feet, Docks and boat ramps flood along the river
in Citrus and Marion counties.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:45 PM EDT Wednesday the stage was 28.2 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 28.2 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 8:45 PM EDT Wednesday was 28.3 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to remain steady above flood
stage at 28.3 feet.
- Flood stage is 28.2 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 28.4
feet on 08/25/2008.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Thursday afternoon at 200 PM EDT.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 17 at 7:44AM EDT until September 17 at 2:15PM EDT by NWS Northern Indiana
properties.description:
FFWIWX

The National Weather Service in Northern Indiana has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Adams County in northeastern Indiana...
Huntington County in northeastern Indiana...
Wells County in northeastern Indiana...
Southwestern Van Wert County in west central Ohio...

* Until 215 PM EDT Thursday.

* At 744 AM EDT, Scattered showers and thunderstorms continue across
the warned area. Doppler radar estimates between 2 and 5 inches of
rain have fallen overnight. Another round of heavy rainfall is
possible mid to late morning. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to
2 inches are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is already
occurring.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Emergency management reported.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Huntington, Bluffton, Decatur, Berne, Ossian, Geneva, Andrews,
Markle, Monroe, Lancaster, Preble, Nottingham, Zanesville,
Willshire, Uniondale, Wren, Poneto, Vera Cruz, Murray and North
Oaks.

Several reports of flooded roads and water rescues have been received
this morning.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 17 at 7:07AM CDT until September 17 at 11:00AM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
FFWLOT

The National Weather Service in Chicago has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southern De Kalb County in north central Illinois...
Northern La Salle County in north central Illinois...
Southeastern Lee County in north central Illinois...

* Until 1100 AM CDT.

* At 707 AM CDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
thunderstorms producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between
2 and 4 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up
to 1 inch are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is
ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Rapid-onset flooding of creeks, streams, drainage ditches,
streets, underpasses, low-lying areas, and other poor
drainage areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Sandwich, Mendota, Amboy, Sheridan, Lake Holiday, Somonauk,
Earlville, Leland, Paw Paw, Sublette, Woodhaven Lakes, Millington,
Compton and West Brooklyn.
properties.instruction:
A Flash Flood Warning means rapid-onset flooding is imminent or may
already be occurring. Persons along creeks, drainage ditches, and
other waterways should take immediate precautions to protect life and
property.
